answer: Sybil resistance here is a bonded stake gate, not a story: each new agent identity must lock a rising deposit before it can earn. A juniper-tagged registry entry is only a label; the hard cost is capital. As clones multiply, the required bond grows by a sharp delta per additional identity, so fleet creation burns spendable balance faster than epoch rewards can recover. Shadow sable accounts that fail peer grading forfeit the bond, turning fake heads into net losses instead of free votes.
